name: Sagar Samman Award- Recognition of Outstanding Maritime Training Institutes
benefit: - Formal national-level recognition to top 3 institutes in each category. - Inter-se ranking to determine 1st, 2nd, and 3rd positions. - Public acknowledgment during National Maritime Day celebrations. - Enhanced institutional reputation and credibility.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a Directorate General of Shipping (DGS) approved maritime training institute. 1. The applicant should have participated in the Comprehensive Inspection Programme (CIP). 1. The applicant should have demonstrated consistent and high performance in training quality and outcomes. 1. The applicant should fall under one of the following categories: - Pre-sea training institutes for Officer Cadets (Nautical & Engineering); - Pre-sea training institutes for Rating Trainees; - Post-sea training institutes conducting Competency Courses.
